arxiv-2203-02585.title: NFSlicer: Data Movement Optimization for Shallow Network Functions
arxiv-2203-02585.creator: Anirudh Sarma, Hamed Seyedroudbari, Harshit Gupta, Umakishore Ramachandran, Alexandros Daglis
arxiv-2203-02585.description: Abstract Network Function (NF) deployments on commodity servers have become ubiquitous in datacenters and enterprise settings. Many commonly used NFs such as firewalls, load balancers and NATs are shallow—i.e., they only examine the packet’s header, despite the entire packet being transferred on and off the server.

arxiv-2211-03288.title: An interpretation of Union-Find Decoder on Weighted Graphs
arxiv-2211-03288.creator: Yue Wu, Namitha Liyanage, and Lin Zhong Department of Computer Science, Yale University, New Haven, CT
arxiv-2211-03288.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yue Wu, Namitha Liyanage, and Lin Zhong Department of Computer Science, Yale University, New Haven, CT. Union-Find (UF) and Minimum-Weight Perfect Matching (MWPM) are popular decoder designs for surface codes. The former has significantly lower time complexity than the latter but is considered somewhat inferior, in terms of decoding accuracy.

arxiv-2311-02497.title: Polaritonic ultracold reactions: cavity controlled molecular photoassociation
arxiv-2311-02497.creator: Vasil Rokaj, Simeon I. Mistakidis, H. R. Sadeghpour
arxiv-2311-02497.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vasil Rokaj, Simeon I. Mistakidis, H. R. Sadeghpour. We introduce a prototypical model for cavity polaritonic control of ultracold photochemistry by considering the resonant vibrational strong coupling of a rubidium dimer ( Rb 2 \rm{Rb_{2}} ) to a terahertz cavity. We demonstrate that at avoided crossings between a vibrational excitation and the vacuum photon absorption, the resulting polaritonic states between the molecule and photons can efficiently control the molecular vibrational Franck-Condon (FC) factors.

arxiv-2311-07779.title: CONTROL THEORY AND PARAMETRIZATIONS OF LINEAR PARTIAL DIFFERENTIAL OPERATORS
arxiv-2311-07779.creator: J.-F. POMMARET
arxiv-2311-07779.description: Abstract ABSTRACT When {\cal{D}}:\xi\rightarrow\eta is a linear ordinary differential (OD) or partial differential (PD) operator, a ”direct problem” is to find the generating compatibility conditions (CC) in the form of an operator {\cal{D}}_{1}:\eta\rightarrow\zeta such that {\cal{D}}\xi=\eta implies {\cal{D}}_{1}\eta=0 . When {\cal{D}} is involutive, the procedure provides successive first order involutive operators {\cal{D}}_{1},...,{\cal{D}}_{n} when the ground manifold has dimension n .

arxiv-2410-04462.title: Tensor-Train Point Cloud Compression and Efficient Approximate Nearest-Neighbor Search
arxiv-2410-04462.creator: Novikov Georgii, Alexander Gneushev, Alexey Kadeishvili, Ivan Oseledets
arxiv-2410-04462.description: Abstract Nearest-neighbor search in large vector databases is crucial for various machine learning applications. This paper introduces a novel method using tensor-train (TT) low-rank tensor decomposition to efficiently represent point clouds and enable fast approximate nearest-neighbor searches. We propose a probabilistic interpretation and utilize density estimation losses like Sliced Wasserstein to train TT decompositions, resulting in robust point cloud compression.

arxiv-2507-22535.title: Scalable and (quantum-accessible) adaptive pseudorandom quantum states and pseudorandom function-like quantum state generators
arxiv-2507-22535.creator: Rishabh Batra, Zhili Chen, Rahul Jain, YaoNan Zhang
arxiv-2507-22535.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rishabh Batra, Zhili Chen, Rahul Jain, YaoNan Zhang. Pseudorandom quantum states (PRS) and pseudorandom function-like quantum state (PRFS) generators are quantum analogues of pseudorandom generators and pseudorandom functions. It is known that PRS (and PRFS) can exist even if BQP = QMA (relative to a quantum oracle) [ Kre21 ] or if P = NP (relative to a classical oracle) [ KQST23 ] , which does not allow for the existence of one-way functions (relative to these oracles).

pmc-10573280.title: Characterization of Hot-Applied Joint Sealants and Their Components in Terms of Their Chemical Composition and Basic Performance Properties
pmc-10573280.creator: Justyna Stępień, Eva Remišová
pmc-10573280.description: Hot- and cold-applied joint sealants are materials commonly used for the surface repairs of the upper layers of asphalt or concrete road surfaces. Our investigations covered six hot-applied joint sealants, classified as the high-extension type N1 (elastic) or low-extension type N2 (normal), in accordance with the standard EN 14188-1; the sealants were obtained commercially from four European manufacturers.

pmc-10647435.title: Assessing the Seafood Trade Diversion Arising from Economic Sanctions: Evidence from Russia and Western Countries
pmc-10647435.creator: Chang Min Kim, Dae Eui Kim, Song Soo Lim, Dayong Zhou
pmc-10647435.description: Since 2014, economic sanctions between Russia and Western nations have significantly altered the global seafood trade. The consequent decline in bilateral trade also had spillover effects on the rest of the world (ROW). According to earlier studies, economic sanctions appear to negatively impact bilateral trade and income.

pmc-11494771.title: Association between loneliness and incident atrial fibrillation across different genetic predisposition: findings from the UK Biobank
pmc-11494771.creator: Zechen Liu, Yanjun Song, Shanshan Shi, Zhihao Zheng, Weihua Song, Wenjia Zhang, Kefei Dou
pmc-11494771.description: BackgroundLoneliness has garnered significant attention globally, with extensive exploration of its association with cardiovascular disease. However, a notable research gap persists concerning loneliness and its potential link to atrial fibrillation (AF).MethodsThis prospective cohort study utilized data from the UK Biobank (UKB), encompassing 441,056 participants. Loneliness was assessed through self-reported questionnaires gauging feelings of isolation and willingness to confide.

pmc-11701509.title: Current options in jaw and facial reconstructions
pmc-11701509.creator: Soung Min Kim, Jong Ho Lee
pmc-11701509.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In recent years, many advances have been made in surgical fields of oral and maxillofacial reconstruction, and the variety and complexity of available surgical approaches consider different functionalities of the jaw and the aesthetics of the face. There is no validated or scientifically proven basis for deciding which flap to use for reconstruction, so decisions are often made based on the direct and indirect experiential knowledge of the reconstructive surgeon.

pmc-12714283.title: EdgeCaseDNet: An enhanced detection architecture for edge case perception in autonomous driving
pmc-12714283.creator: Yin Lei, Chen Shan, Wancheng Ge, Alessio Plebe, Alessio Plebe, Alessio Plebe, Alessio Plebe
pmc-12714283.description: Autonomous driving perception systems still encounter significant challenges in edge scenarios involving multi-scale target changes and adverse weather, which seriously compromise detection reliability. To address this issue, we introduce a novel edge case dataset that extends existing benchmarks by capturing extreme road conditions (fog, rain, snow, nighttime et al.) with precise annotations, and develop EdgeCaseDNet as an optimized object-detection framework.

pmc-13227078.title: Biochemical and functional characterization of Porphyromonas gingivalis HmuS protein reveals its participation in heme metabolism
pmc-13227078.creator: Patryk Cierpisz, Michał Śmiga, Michał Tracz, Ronivaldo Rodrigues da Silva, Jennifer L. DuBois, Teresa Olczak
pmc-13227078.description: BackgroundPorphyromonas gingivalis lacks the complete heme biosynthesis pathway and does not utilize siderophores to acquire iron. The exact mechanism of iron extraction from heme in this bacterium is unknown. This study aimed to characterize the P. gingivalis HmuSPg protein and to compare its properties with those of the Bacteroides fragilis homologous protein.

pmc-13648132.title: Reactive airways dysfunction syndrome following acute lithium hydroxide dust exposure at a battery material production plant: a case series of 16 workers
pmc-13648132.creator: Chul Gab Lee, Soo Hyeong Park, Jeong Joon Park, Han Soo Song, Hyeon Kyeong Ko, Sung Ho Yoon
pmc-13648132.description: BackgroundReactive airways dysfunction syndrome (RADS) is an acute-onset form of irritant-induced asthma that occurs after a single high-concentration exposure to irritants. Although RADS has been documented for chlorine, ammonia, and acid fumes, no published case series has attributed RADS to lithium hydroxide (LiOH) dust inhalation.

pmc-13672133.title: Second‐Harmonic Generation Enhancement in Polar Dielectric Films via Nonlocal Longitudinal Modes and Berreman Modes
pmc-13672133.creator: Yining Yao, Ye Zhang, Jie Luo, Dongliang Gao, Hao Hu, Lei Gao
pmc-13672133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Polar dielectrics offer considerable promise for mid‐infrared nanophotonics and nonlinear optics because of their low optical losses and spectral bands of negative permittivity. However, previous studies have generally shown that nonlocal effects in polar dielectrics lead to suppression effects. This work reveals a different phenomenon, whereby we utilize the nonlocal effect to achieve second‐harmonic generation (SHG) enhancement in polar dielectric films. Specifically, the longitudinal‐mode resonances in polar dielectrics introduce multiple longitudinal resonances.

pmc-13677440.title: Late-onset hypothalamic–pituitary dysfunction in a childhood cancer survivor treated with cranial irradiation
pmc-13677440.creator: Yuria Takamura, Reiko Inoue, Koji Takeuchi, Fukuo Kosokabe, Kota Ishizawa, Daisuke Inoue
pmc-13677440.description: Hypothalamic–pituitary dysfunction is a well-recognized late complication in childhood cancer survivors (CCSs) treated with cranial irradiation. We report a 42-year-old male with a history of acute lymphoblastic leukemia diagnosed at 5 years of age and treated with chemotherapy and 26 Gray whole-brain irradiation. He presented with right upper extremity paresis due to bilateral chronic subdural hematomas.
